changes.new_text: In non-highway environments, the system shall only make the vehicle automatically accelerate from standstill, if both of the following conditions are fulfilled at the moment of drive off: (a) the driver is not deemed to be visually disengaged as per paragraph 5.5.4.2.5. for more than 2 seconds immediately prior to the drive off; and (b) the system has confirmed there is no risk of collision detected along the drive-off path.
